title: AliExpress’ Singles’ Day Sale Is a Tech Lover’s Dream, From Gaming Consoles to Karaoke Machines
summary: The annual shopping event runs through Nov. 18, bringing deals on music and gaming essentials alongside products from Brand+ sellers.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

Your next tech obsession might be a lot more affordable than you expected. AliExpress’ annual Singles’ Day sale is back until Nov.18, bringing deals on everything from Bluetooth speakers and gaming gear to smart rings and digital pianos.

Shop Aliexpress singles' day sale

And if your music setup could use some attention, there’s plenty to browse. A mini karaoke machine is practically begging for a living room singalong, while the W-KING Bluetooth speaker can take your playlists on the road. Gamers can check out the Retroid Pocket 5 handheld console or Edifier G35 headset , and aspiring musicians can get started with a 61-key digital piano .

The deals aren’t the only draw. AliExpress’ Brand+ is a dedication shopping destination bringing together products from trusted brands with enhanced servicing at competitive prices. From tech and beauty to home essentials, shoppers can explore a wide range of products, with free returns on eligible purchases.

Even better, most Brand+ products ship free without a minimum order requirement. AliExpress also says 95% of U.S.-available products qualify for fast delivery guarantee, with coupons for qualifying delays and refunds for eligible lost, damaged or late shipments. 

The sale ends Nov. 18, so consider this your cue to upgrade your tech before the holiday shopping rush begins.

The Best AliExpress Singles’ Day Deals  

BRAND+

AliExpress Edifier G35 Gaming Headset

$39.33 $93.66 58% off

Buy Now at aliexpress

A good gaming headset can make all the difference, especially when every sound counts. Edifier’s G35 delivers 7.1 virtual surround sound through 50mm drivers, while a detachable noise-canceling microphone helps keep your voice clear during multiplayer sessions.

AliExpress W-KING Deep Bass Bluetooth Speaker

$58.79 $176.37 67% off

From bass-heavy hip-hop tracks to your favorite dance anthems, the W-KING D9-1 is built to give your music some extra punch. It packs 60W RMS output, dual woofers and a 7.2-inch passive bass radiator, plus up to 40 hours of playback at low volume.

AliExpress Retroid Pocket 5 Handheld Game Console

$235.53 $841.50 72% off

Don’t let its compact size fool you. The Retroid Pocket 5 runs on a Snapdragon 865 processor with Android 13, while its 5.5-inch AMOLED screen, Wi-Fi 6 connectivity and expandable storage round out a portable gaming setup.

AliExpress COLMI R06 Smart Ring

$7.74 $60.14 87% off

Curious about smart rings but not ready to spend hundreds on one? The COLMI R06 offers a budget-friendly introduction to wearable tech, tracking your heart rate, sleep patterns, daily steps and activity levels through a companion smartphone app.

AliExpress SucceBuy 61 Key Digital Keyboard Piano

$32.74 $101.25 68% off

The SucceBuy digital keyboard gives beginners plenty to work with, including 61 keys, a metronome and recording and playback functions. Depending on the model, it offers up to 600 tones and 500 rhythms, allowing players to explore different sounds as their skills improve.

AliExpress W-KING T9-M2 Portable Karaoke Speaker

$127.39 $296.26 57% off

For anyone who likes their music loud and their bass even louder, the W-KING T9-M2 delivers 80W RMS output with a 180W peak rating. The portable speaker also includes two wireless microphones and RGB lighting, so it’s just as ready for karaoke night as it is for a party playlist.
